newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 497,000 metric tons (MT) were 11 percent above the previous week and 6 percent over the 4-week average.

Major increases reported for the Philippines (109,700 MT), Japan (104,800 MT), Iraq (50,000 MT--the first activity since the 1989/90 marketing year), and Thailand (35,000 MT). In addition, changes in destinations for 31,000 MT of white wheat were reported from the United Kingdom to Yemen.
Sales activity of 49,000 MT for the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for Israel (41,000 MT).

Exports of 307,700 MT were off 24 percent from the week earlier and 21 percent from the 4-week average. The principal recipients were Japan (72,800 MT), Pakistan (63,000 MT), Mexico (48,100 MT), and the Philippines (45,300 MT).
